outstanding: Do not navigate from proposal acceptance or analysis progress to medical, training or erasure success before the authoritative server receipt; generated state frames are illustrative only.
True fixed header/footer and independent middle scrolling, actual 390px viewport, clipping, focus, Escape, keyboard, screen readers and pixel-level layout still require Viewer acceptance.
Chat actual run_id, answer interaction_id, idempotency persistence, and DomainCommitReceipt cannot be validated by synthetic Penpot click flows.
Diagnosis adopted count/evidence, Trainer safety/session commands and erasure copy-by-copy verification require Track A/C backend integration and review.
Some of the 42 original state variants are intentionally not yet composited; remaining domain conditional scenarios and production VM parity are not fully signed off.
